open Filter

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux1 (L : ℕ) (G : Type*)
    [AddCommMonoid G] [Fintype G] (hL : 0 < L) (hG : ∀ g : G, L • g = 0) :
    ∀ a : Fin (Fintype.card G * (L - 1) + 1) → G,
      ∃ I : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card G * (L - 1) + 1)),
        I.card = L ∧ ∑ i ∈ I, a i = 0 := by
  classical
  intro a
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Fintype.exists_lt_card_fiber_of_mul_lt_card a
    (show Fintype.card G * (L - 1) <
      Fintype.card (Fin (Fintype.card G * (L - 1) + 1)) by simp)
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (show L ≤
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a i = g)).card by omega)
  refine ⟨I, hcard, ?_⟩
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ I, a i = ∑ _i ∈ I, g := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hI hi)).2
    _ = L • g := by simp [hcard]
    _ = 0 := hG g

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux2 (c b : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    Tendsto (fun r : ℕ => (c * b ^ r) ^ (1 / (r : ℝ))) atTop (nhds b) := by
  have h : Tendsto (fun r : ℕ => c ^ (1 / (r : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 1) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds.rpow tendsto_one_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
      (Or.inl (ne_of_gt hc)) : Tendsto (fun r : ℕ => c ^ (1 / (r : ℝ)))
        atTop (nhds (c ^ (0 : ℝ))))
  have hmul := h.mul_const b
  simp only [one_mul] at hmul
  apply hmul.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with r hr
  rw [Real.mul_rpow hc.le (pow_nonneg hb _)]
  congr 1
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast_mul hb]
  rw [show (r : ℝ) * (1 / (r : ℝ)) = 1 by
    have hr0 : (r : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show r ≠ 0 by omega)
    field_simp, Real.rpow_one]

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux3 (n r : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n) ≤ n * n ^ r := by
  let : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hw := x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux1 n (Fin r → ZMod n) (by omega) (by
    intro g
    ext j
    simp [nsmul_eq_mul])
  have h : x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n) ≤
      Fintype.card (Fin r → ZMod n) * (n - 1) + 1 := csInf_le' hw
  have hp : 1 ≤ n ^ r := one_le_pow₀ (by omega)
  have hpred : n - 1 + 1 = n := by omega
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin r → ZMod n) = n ^ r := by simp
  rw [hcard] at h
  nlinarith

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux4 (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) atTop
      (fun r : ℕ => (x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n) : ℝ) ^ (1 / (r : ℝ))) := by
  have h := x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux2 (n : ℝ) (n : ℝ) (by positivity) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h.isBoundedUnder_le
  change ∀ᶠ r : ℕ in atTop, ((n : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ r) ^ (1 / (r : ℝ)) ≤ M at hM
  refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
  change ∀ᶠ r : ℕ in atTop, (x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n) : ℝ) ^ (1 / (r : ℝ)) ≤ M
  filter_upwards [hM] with r hr
  apply le_trans _ hr
  apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) _ (by positivity)
  exact_mod_cast x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux3 n r hn

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux5 (f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hbounded : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) atTop (fun r : ℕ => f r ^ (1 / (r : ℝ))))
    (c b : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hbelow : ∀ᶠ r : ℕ in atTop, c * b ^ r ≤ f r) :
    b ≤ liminf (fun r : ℕ => f r ^ (1 / (r : ℝ))) atTop := by
  have hlim := x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux2 c b hc hb
  have hcmp : ∀ᶠ r : ℕ in atTop,
      (c * b ^ r) ^ (1 / (r : ℝ)) ≤ f r ^ (1 / (r : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hbelow] with r hr
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (mul_nonneg hc.le (pow_nonneg hb _)) hr (by positivity)
  have h := liminf_le_liminf hcmp hlim.isBoundedUnder_ge
    hbounded.isCoboundedUnder_ge
  rwa [hlim.liminf_eq] at h

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux6 (c b : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    Tendsto (fun r : ℕ => (c * b ^ r + 1) ^ (1 / (r : ℝ))) atTop (nhds b) := by
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le
    (x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux2 c b hc (by linarith))
    (x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux2 (c + 1) b (by linarith) (by linarith))
  · intro r
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) (by linarith) (by positivity)
  · intro r
    have hp : 1 ≤ b ^ r := one_le_pow₀ hb
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) (by nlinarith) (by positivity)

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux7 {α ι : Type*} (n : ℕ) (I : Finset α)
    (a : α → ι → Fin 2) (hcard : I.card = n)
    (hzero : (∑ i ∈ I, (fun j : ι => ((a i j).val : ZMod n))) = 0) :
    ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ k ∈ I, a i = a k := by
  classical
  intro i hi k hk
  funext j
  apply Fin.ext
  have hz : (((∑ x ∈ I, (a x j).val) : ℕ) : ZMod n) = 0 := by
    have h := congrFun hzero j
    simpa only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.zero_apply, Nat.cast_sum] using h
  have hdvd : n ∣ ∑ x ∈ I, (a x j).val := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hz
  have hle : (∑ x ∈ I, (a x j).val) ≤ n := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _x ∈ I, 1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => by omega)
      _ = n := by simp [hcard]
  by_cases hs : (∑ x ∈ I, (a x j).val) = n
  · have heq : (∑ x ∈ I, (a x j).val) = ∑ _x ∈ I, 1 := by simpa [hcard]
    have hall := (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le (fun x (_hx : x ∈ I) =>
      show (a x j).val ≤ 1 by omega)).mp heq
    rw [hall i hi, hall k hk]
  · have hslt : (∑ x ∈ I, (a x j).val) < n := lt_of_le_of_ne hle hs
    have hzeroN := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt hdvd hslt
    have hall : ∀ x ∈ I, (a x j).val = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.mp hzeroN
    rw [hall i hi, hall k hk]

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux8 (n r : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    (n - 1) * 2 ^ r + 1 ≤ x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n) := by
  classical
  let : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hne : ({s : ℕ | ∀ a : Fin s → (Fin r → ZMod n),
      ∃ I : Finset (Fin s), I.card = n ∧ ∑ i ∈ I, a i = 0} : Set ℕ).Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨Fintype.card (Fin r → ZMod n) * (n - 1) + 1, ?_⟩
    exact x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux1 n (Fin r → ZMod n) (by omega) (by
      intro g
      ext j
      simp [nsmul_eq_mul])
  have hs : ∀ a : Fin (x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n)) → (Fin r → ZMod n),
      ∃ I : Finset (Fin (x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n))),
        I.card = n ∧ ∑ i ∈ I, a i = 0 := Nat.sInf_mem hne
  by_contra! hlt
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le (α := Fin (x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n)))
    (β := Fin (n - 1) × (Fin r → Fin 2)) (by simp; omega)
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hzero⟩ := hs (fun i j => (((e i).2 j).val : ZMod n))
  have heq := x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux7 n I (fun i => (e i).2) hI hzero
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun i => (e i).1) I := by
    intro i hi k hk hik
    apply e.injective
    exact Prod.ext hik (heq i hi k hk)
  have hbound : I.card ≤ n - 1 := by
    calc
      I.card = (I.image (fun i => (e i).1)).card := (Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj).symm
      _ ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n - 1))).card := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ _)
      _ = n - 1 := by simp
  omega

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux9 (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    2 ≤ Filter.liminf (fun r : ℕ =>
      (x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n) : ℝ) ^ (1 / (r : ℝ))) Filter.atTop := by
  apply x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux5
    (fun r : ℕ => (x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n) : ℝ))
    (x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux4 n hn) ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) 2
    (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n - 1 by omega)) (by norm_num)
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro r
  have h := x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux8 n r hn
  exact_mod_cast (show (n - 1) * 2 ^ r ≤ x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n) by omega)

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux10 (r : ℕ) :
    x2611_15210_s 2 (Fin r → ZMod 2) = 2 ^ r + 1 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h : x2611_15210_s 2 (Fin r → ZMod 2) ≤
        Fintype.card (Fin r → ZMod 2) * (2 - 1) + 1 := by
      apply csInf_le'
      exact x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux1 2 (Fin r → ZMod 2) (by omega) (by
        intro g
        ext j
        change (2 : ℕ) • g j = 0
        rw [nsmul_eq_mul]
        rw [show ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod 2) = 0 from ZMod.natCast_self 2, zero_mul])
    simpa using h
  · simpa using x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux8 2 r (by omega)

theorem x2611_15210_thm1_1 (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ((∃ a : ℕ, n = 2 ^ a) → Filter.liminf (fun r : ℕ =>
      (x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n) : ℝ) ^ (1 / (r : ℝ))) Filter.atTop = 2) ∧
    ((¬ ∃ a : ℕ, n = 2 ^ a) → 2 < Filter.liminf (fun r : ℕ =>
      (x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n) : ℝ) ^ (1 / (r : ℝ))) Filter.atTop) := by
  have H :
      (∀ k r : ℕ, 2 ≤ k →
        x2611_15210_s (2 * k) (Fin r → ZMod (2 * k)) + 1 ≤
          2 * x2611_15210_s k (Fin r → ZMod k) + 2 ^ r) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → (¬ ∃ a : ℕ, k = 2 ^ a) →
        ∃ c b : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 2 < b ∧ ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r →
          c * b ^ r ≤ (x2611_15210_s k (Fin r → ZMod k) : ℝ)) := by
    constructor
    · clear n hn
      sorry
    · clear n hn
      sorry
  obtain ⟨hstep, hnonpower⟩ := H
  have hpower : ∀ a r : ℕ,
      x2611_15210_s (2 ^ (a + 1)) (Fin r → ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1))) =
        (2 ^ (a + 1) - 1) * 2 ^ r + 1 := by
    intro a
    induction a with
    | zero =>
      intro r
      simpa using x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux10 r
    | succ a ih =>
      intro r
      have hk : 2 ≤ 2 ^ (a + 1) := by
        have h : 1 ≤ 2 ^ a := one_le_pow₀ (by omega)
        rw [pow_succ]
        omega
      have hmul : 2 ^ (a + 1 + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ (a + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; omega
      change x2611_15210_s (2 ^ (a + 1 + 1)) (Fin r → ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1 + 1))) = _
      apply le_antisymm
      · have hu := hstep (2 ^ (a + 1)) r hk
        rw [ih r] at hu
        rw [hmul]
        have hp : 2 ^ (a + 1) - 1 + 1 = 2 ^ (a + 1) := by omega
        have hq : 2 * 2 ^ (a + 1) - 1 + 1 = 2 * 2 ^ (a + 1) := by omega
        nlinarith
      · exact x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux8 _ r (by rw [hmul]; omega)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    cases a with
    | zero => norm_num at hn
    | succ a =>
      have hc : 0 < ((2 ^ (a + 1) - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (show 0 < 2 ^ (a + 1) - 1 by omega)
      have hl := x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux6 ((2 ^ (a + 1) - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) 2 hc (by norm_num)
      apply Filter.Tendsto.liminf_eq
      convert hl using 1
      ext r
      rw [hpower a r]
      push_cast
      rfl
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨c, b, hc, hb, hbelow⟩ := hnonpower n hn hp
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le hb
    apply x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux5
      (fun r : ℕ => (x2611_15210_s n (Fin r → ZMod n) : ℝ))
      (x2611_15210_thm1_1_aux4 n hn) c b hc (by linarith)
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with r hr
    exact hbelow r hr
